title: Effectus Amoris: network critical edition of a 16th-century Hungarian verse romance
institution: ELTE BTK Magyar Irodalomtörténeti Intézet (Reneszánszkutatások Posztgraduális Központja), edited by Tóth Tünde and Béla Szegedi; published by Gépeskönyv
notes: Hungarian verse romance (széphistória) surviving only as damaged printed leaves from a Debrecen print of 1587-1588. Three free text versions: a letter-faithful critical transcription, a pronunciation-oriented text and a modern-language text, plus photographs. words = our own count of the letter-faithful transcription (the source's own front matter and instructions excluded); counts include the short Latin argument and commonplace. The site is a hand-made 1998-99 HTML publication; the server reports a last modification in 2006 and no later change was found.
license_note: Copyright statement of the editor and publisher (1998-99); no open licence stated.
